name: Russia–NATO
summary: Drone attacks on ships off Romania and Bulgaria; Romania blames Russia
state: Drones hit at least seven cargo ships off Romania and Bulgaria in October, including one sunk off Bulgaria on 13 Oct; Romania blamed Russia after a drone sank a ship on 23 Oct. No NATO member had requested Article 4 consultations and no new attack off NATO coasts was reported as of 2 Nov.
for_you: No direct threat to the UK. Those travelling to the Baltic or Black Sea region can check FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Attacks off NATO coasts attributed to Russia by Romania = Watch

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Drone attack sinks ship off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
